Binds from the property bag: target, depth, stencil, normal, surface, heatmap (opt), depth_hierarchy (opt), final_output, a name printf-built from 'scene', plus 8 MD5-hashed fixed target names (3 shared with the RT lighting pass). Reads int 'downscale' (default 1) into impl+0x2f4. Allocates 0x3a0 impl (vtable 0x1459b7350) at +0x550 with float defaults (+0x288 100.0, +0x28c 0.53, +0x294 0.99, 0.002/0.001, 0.75/2.2, 0.005, ints 128/1/4/2, +0x2dc 0.9) and sets impl+0x369=1 when device (0x14618eaa8)+0x39e8 == 1. Exact effect not proven: likely screen-space/ray-traced reflections using a Hi-Z depth chain. Impl defaults are tunable constants.
